notes.title: Khitarii and Khimoshi, an Update (1/2)
notes.content:
Hello! Recently, a lot of new people have become interested in this game.

I have been receiving a lot of questions.

When is Khitarii and Khimoshi ACTUALLY releasing???
What is Khitarii and Khimoshi? Is it a visual novel?
Who is Khitarii and who is Khimoshi?
WhErE Is kHiTaRi aNd kHiMoShI?
WHY KHITARII AND KHIMOSHI?

I would like to answer these, but I am not quite ready for an update yet.

Within three weeks, I will give a formal status update.

See ya soon!
